articles.summary: The Artist Tree is a West Hollywood-based cannabis brand that combines dispensary retail with gallery-inspired art spaces across 11 California locations, including on-site consumption lounges in West Hollywood and Hawthorne. Founded in 2019 by Lauren Fontein, Avi Kahan, Mitch Kahan, and Aviv Halimi, the brand pairs curated local artwork with cannabis education and community events. In 2026, The Artist Tree opens its first New York dispensary in Farmingdale, Long Island, extending its art-driven retail model beyond California.
articles.title: How The Artist Tree Turned Cannabis Retail Into an Art Gallery in West Hollywood

articles.summary: Humboldt Family Farms is building the infrastructure that enables independent Humboldt County growers to reach California dispensary shelves under their own names.
articles.title: Inside Humboldt Family Farms: How One California Collective Is Shifting Consumers to Craft Sungrown Cannabis

articles.summary: A "dime" means two things: a nod to street culture's legacy dime bag, and modern slang for a perfect 10. Dime Industries built its name — and now a #4-ranked national vape brand — on both.
articles.title: How Street Culture and "Top-Tier" Became One Name at Dime Industries
